# Extra Medium

> Extra Medium is a founder-led strategy, creative, growth and technology studio and product lab based in Virginia Beach, Virginia (Extra Medium LLC). It launches, reinvents and grows businesses for clients from pre-launch startups to Fortune 100 companies, and builds its own products in Extra Medium Labs — led by Magpie, a live local creator marketing platform in 45 founding markets across 13 countries. Founder and principal: Jeff Rimmer, 20+ years in marketing on every side of the table.

## Studio
- [Work](https://xmedium.co/work/): Case stories — growth systems, brand reinvention, enterprise launches, and the studio's own products.
- [Studio services](https://xmedium.co/services/): Launch, Reinvent, Grow, Lead (fractional CMO), Intelligence (AI consulting, agents, automation), Experiences. Three engagement shapes: fractional leadership, project, ongoing growth.
- [About](https://xmedium.co/about/): Founder Jeff Rimmer, the name story, and the studio's six working principles.
- [Contact](https://xmedium.co/contact/): Start a conversation. Email hello@xmedium.co. Replies usually within one business day.

## Labs
- [Extra Medium Labs](https://xmedium.co/labs/): The studio's product lab. Flagship: Magpie. Core project: Hapsta (live at hapsta.co — small capped live video rooms where fans hang out or play games with famous people; the celebrity sets the price and keeps 80%). In development: Roon (family memory platform), JAWNRA (music discovery and charts).
- [Magpie case study](https://xmedium.co/labs/magpie/): Magpie is a local creator marketing platform built and operated by Extra Medium. Local businesses comp or pay creators who live in their city (500 followers is enough; tiers Neighbors 500–2k, Locals 2k–15k, Headliners 15k+) to visit and post honestly within 48 hours; every visit is tracked to register spend. Business plans and pricing are published on the product site; paid bookings pay creators 97%. Product site: https://magpielocal.com, app: https://app.magpielocal.com. Operated by Extra Medium LLC.

## Key facts
- Headquarters: Virginia Beach, Virginia, US; presence in Chicago and London; clients across the US and UK.
- Founder Jeff Rimmer previously founded a digital music platform that grew past 900,000 users.
- Industries: consumer products, ecommerce, healthcare and medical devices, retail, media and broadcast, music and entertainment, hospitality, professional services, technology and SaaS.
- Magpie status (November 2026): live platform, founding-market formation, home market Virginia Beach activating first.

## Magazine — Extra Extra (https://xmedium.co/magazine/)
- Extra Extra is Extra Medium's magazine: marketing, advertising, music, media, and dispatches from the lab. New article most days.
- [The Room Got Small](https://xmedium.co/magazine/the-room-got-small/): Hapsta and the shift from watching celebrities to being in the room with them.
- [Magpie announcement (press release)](https://xmedium.co/magazine/magpie-announcement/): Extra Medium Labs announces Magpie, the local creator marketing platform ranked by local reach.
- [What a Fractional CMO Actually Does All Week](https://xmedium.co/magazine/what-a-fractional-cmo-does/)
- [The Local Advertiser Didn't Leave. The Audience Did.](https://xmedium.co/magazine/the-local-advertiser/)
- [Your Logo Is Not Your Brand](https://xmedium.co/magazine/your-logo-is-not-your-brand/)
- [Inside the Lab](https://xmedium.co/magazine/inside-the-lab/): why a marketing agency builds its own products.
- [The Chart That Lies](https://xmedium.co/magazine/the-chart-that-lies/): Popularity tells you who won. Momentum tells you who is next. Why JAWNRA measures movement, not totals.
- [Is SEO Dead? What AI Search Actually Changed](https://xmedium.co/magazine/is-seo-dead/): People still search, but an AI answer now comes first. Why clear pages with real proof get cited, and vague ones get skipped.
- [What Do You Do With Thousands of Family Photos No One Ever Looks At?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/what-to-do-with-family-photos/): The camera roll kept everything and organized nothing. Why a family archive needs chapters and stories, not bigger folders, and what Roon is building about it.
- [How Much Does Influencer Marketing Cost for a Local Business?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/how-much-does-influencer-marketing-cost/): A comped visit costs the experience itself. A paid post costs the creator's rate. Why local reach, not follower count, is the number to price against.
- [How Much Should a Small Business Spend on Marketing?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/how-much-should-a-small-business-spend-on-marketing/): There is no honest single percentage. Build the budget from what a customer is worth and the growth you need, fund consistency before scale, and judge it by customers gained.
- [How Long Does It Take for Marketing to Work?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/how-long-does-marketing-take-to-work/): Some channels move in days. Most move in months. The honest timeline depends on what you bought, how clear the offer is, and whether you stayed long enough to read the result.
- [Do You Still Need a Website If You Have Social Media?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/do-you-need-a-website-if-you-have-social-media/): Social media rents attention; a website owns where it lands. Why a profile is good for discovery but a site carries the full offer, proof, and next step, and is what search and AI answers cite.
- [How Does a Song Break Now?](https://xmedium.co/magazine/how-does-a-song-break-now/): A song breaks in small rooms first: saves, shares, and second listens, then creators and local scenes carry it wider. Why momentum, not totals, is the early signal, and what JAWNRA is built to measure.

## Merch
- [Merch](https://xmedium.co/merch/): Extra Medium merch — the store is open. Ten pieces, each with its own product page: the Wordmark Tee (cream or black, $35), the Lockup Tee ($35), the Lockup Long Sleeve ($45), the Back Print Tee ($35), four collage tees (Cloud, Dove, Eyes, Mic, $35 each) and two trucker hats (Newsboy, Wordmark, $30 each). Tees run S–3XL. Printed to order; prices include US shipping.
